purpose: Qualify the smallest seed-free automatic detector for the already-qualified O14 1 cm surface-cap event. The candidate may use only the committed pre-cap state, forcing, cap, horizon and qualified face contracts. Frozen A4/A8 event roots may be used only after the candidate solve as qualification reference, never as candidate seed or detector input.

candidate_detection_policy.step_1_no_event_certificate: If S0 + max(q_supply,0)*DeltaT < S_cap, cap onset is impossible even with zero infiltration. Return NO_CAP_EVENT_SUPPLY_VOLUME_CERTIFIED with zero nonlinear soil/event trajectories.
candidate_detection_policy.step_2_initial_surface_flux: Otherwise evaluate the qualified candidate 5 cm surface face once at the committed S0 and committed top-node head to obtain q_top0.
candidate_detection_policy.step_3_event_seed: Require q_supply > q_top0. Set tau_seed=(S_cap-S0)/(q_supply-q_top0). Candidate fails closed if tau_seed is nonfinite or outside (0,DeltaT).
candidate_detection_policy.step_4_single_event_corrector: Solve [h0,h1,h2,tau] once with the exact A8 cap-event mass equations, bounds h_i in [-10000,-1e-8] cm and tau in (0,DeltaT). Initial heads are exactly the committed heads; tau initial guess is tau_seed. No A4/A8 event head or event-time seed is available to the candidate.
candidate_detection_policy.step_5_acceptance: Accept only a finite strict-interior event root with negative top-node head, physical head ordering, no unqualified face route, hard mass closure and qualified surface-face cost/accuracy. Until acceptance the committed state and runoff ledger remain unchanged.

reference_policy.positive_event: A8 independent high-accuracy event corrector using the already frozen A4 root only as qualification-oracle seed. This reference seed is not exposed to candidate detection.
reference_policy.negative_controls: Supply-volume impossibility is an algebraic certificate and requires no reference trajectory.

cost_and_state_guards.candidate_positive_path: one initial surface-face evaluation plus one constrained event corrector

hard_guards: Do not use A4 or A8 event heads/times as candidate seed, bracket, lookup or hidden initialization.
Do not add a full-interval predictor, repeated trajectory bisection or multi-start search after execution.
Do not alter the four profiles, 1 cm cap, 12*KSAT positive forcing, negative-control forcing, -15 cm bottom head or 0.05 d horizon after execution.
Do not relax event, mass, face-cost or reference-agreement thresholds.
Do not publish event scratch before all acceptance checks pass.
Do not interpret the supply-volume no-event certificate as sufficient when it is inconclusive; inconclusive cases remain outside A9 scope and must fail closed or route to later detector research.
Do not add other materials, cap heights, top-node saturation, response tangents, runtime, MultiSWAP or groundwater to A9.

architecture_checks.5_worker_scratch: Event corrector vectors and seed are worker-local.
architecture_checks.7_transactionality: Detection and correction are scratch-only until accepted event commit; no-event and synthetic reject paths preserve state and ledger.
architecture_checks.8_warm_start: Seed derives only from committed state and forcing, not an externally supplied event trajectory.
architecture_checks.9_generic_time: tau is a generic offset in [0,DeltaT].
architecture_checks.13_mass_conservation: Accepted event must close below 1e-9 cm with no repair.
architecture_checks.24_predictable_runtime: One event corrector for positive cases; zero nonlinear solves for algebraically impossible controls.
architecture_checks.25_reference_mode: A8 reference is qualification-only and invisible to candidate initialization.
architecture_checks.28_runtime_composition: Event detector composes surface and soil contracts; it does not enter the Ross face kernel.

hard_nonclaims: No generic bracket discovery for cases where the supply-volume certificate is inconclusive and the direct corrector fails.
No production event detector, runtime or MultiSWAP admission.
No response tangent through event detection.
